title: HustleBox v1.1.2 — Marcus Has a Face Now
message:
Big update. Real Marcus, real story, real cinematics, real bugs squashed.

MARCUS HAS A FACE
• The 🧢 emoji is gone. Marcus is now a hand-drawn SVG character — head, hair, eyes, mouth, baseball cap with a tiny amber HustleBox brand dot, orange hoodie. He shows up in the top bar avatar and on the Profile hero card.

DYNAMIC PROFILE STORY
• 'The Story So Far' on Profile now branches on FOUR dimensions instead of one: money tier × reputation × skill rate × experience.
• High rep gets a 'word on the block is good' line. Low rep gets 'block doesn't trust you.'
• High perfect-order rate gets 'Ray noticed: you got a touch.' Bad streak gets 'Ray says you need to focus.'
• 50+ customers unlocks 'You know the rhythm.' 200+ unlocks 'feels like home.'

EXTENDED END-OF-SHIFT CINEMATIC
• Ending a shift now plays a multi-stage sequence:
  1. Truck idling at the curb (engine rumble audio)
  2. Truck drives off down the block
  3. Goodbye dialogue between Ray and Marcus
  4. Marcus walks home (footsteps audio)
  5. House at night with floating Z's (snore audio)
  6. Final summary card with stats and 'Get Some Sleep' button
• All audio is synthesized with Web Audio API — no asset files. Respects the Sound setting.
• Hit 'Skip ›' if you don't want the cinematic.

VISUAL THEME — SIDE MENUS GET MESSY FOOD-TRUCK LOOK
• Update Log: every version is now a paper receipt with dotted leader lines, perforated edges, and Courier text. The whole thing wraps in a chalkboard-framed panel.
• Friends, Arcade, and Achievements: same chalkboard panel treatment. Brushed wood frame, brass rivet corners, chalk-style title text.
• Main game (Home, Work, Profile) keeps the brushstroke/AMOLED aesthetic — split is intentional.

BUG FIXES
• Fixed: random events could repeat back-to-back (eventLog was being read but never written).
• Fixed: 'DAY N' counter was stuck at DAY 1 forever (jobsCompleted never incremented).
• Fixed: ending a shift while a result was showing could trigger a phantom new customer (dangling setTimeout closure).

No save data wiped. Settings, Stacks, rep, all carry over.

entries.title: Marcus Has a Face Now
highlights: Marcus is a hand-drawn SVG character — replaces the 🧢 emoji
Profile story branches on rep × skill × experience × money (was money only)
Extended end-of-shift cinematic: truck → drive-off → goodbye → walk home → sleep
Engine rumble, footsteps, door close, snore — all synthesized with Web Audio API
'Skip ›' button to bypass the cinematic
Update Log redressed as paper receipts inside a chalkboard frame
Friends/Arcade/Achievements get chalkboard frame treatment
Fixed: random events repeating back-to-back
Fixed: DAY counter stuck at DAY 1
Fixed: phantom customer firing after end shift

entries.title: Hotfix
highlights: Fixed mouse-wheel scroll being eaten by the sidebar on desktop
OPEN sign now starts the shift when clicked
Sidebar logo made smaller and more subtle
Removed wasted bottom padding on desktop
Defensive z-index on all buttons

entries.title: Cook Like You Mean It
highlights: Drag-and-drop ingredient assembly (replaces tap-in-order)
Tap plate items to remove if you misclicked
Order ticket is now a paper receipt with prices and a total
Food truck screen redressed: diamond plate, stainless counter, rivets
Build plate sits on the counter with 3D perspective
Customer card with bobbing animation when patience is low
Big SERVE bell button instead of auto-completion
Bottom nav icons get a glow halo when active
Order length 2–4 (was 3–5), timer more generous

entries.title: Quality of Life
highlights: Theatrical shift opening — OPEN sign drop, Ray reacts to your rep
Chalkboard menu board with prices
End-of-shift overlay with walking-home animation + summary
Profile redesigned with hero card and evolving story
Smoother iOS-style toggle animations
Back buttons in all settings sub-screens
Removed Reduce Motion and Username fields
Create Account (Coming Soon) replaces Cloud Save

entries.title: Official Branding
highlights: Official HustleBox brushstroke logo wired into the app
Custom sun + skyline app icon
Logo shown in sidebar and About
Cache assets updated for the new visuals

entries.title: Welcome to the Block
highlights: Initial release
Food Truck job playable
Stacks wallet + idle income ticker
Reputation 0–100 system
Rank progression (Broke → Legend)
Random events foundation
Achievement system foundation
Settings screen
Friends, Arcade, and additional jobs coming soon
